privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
Career Simulator does not require sign-up for the free simulation.

Data we process: your wizard answers, locale, checklist progress, and simulation history are stored in your browser localStorage. Optional Supabase sync may store the same in the cloud if enabled.

On POST /api/simulate we use a hashed daily IP counter for the free rate limit (default 1/day). OpenAI keys, if set, stay server-side only.

We do not sell personal data. B2B/Premium waitlist emails are stored locally until a backend is connected.

Ages 12+. Under 16 we recommend using the app with a parent.

Questions: hello@careersimulator.app

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.body:
Career Simulator is an educational tool, not career counseling, therapy, or legal advice.

Salaries, AI-risk, and roadmaps are estimates. Real outcomes depend on region, experience, and employers.

Use at your own risk. We do not guarantee employment or accuracy.

Automated abuse of the API (scraping, bypassing rate limits) is prohibited.

We may update these terms on this page. Continued use means you accept the current version.

about.title: About
about.body:
Career Simulator helps teens explore careers: 15 questions → 5 matches with salary, AI-risk, and a 30-day roadmap. 200+ professions in the catalog.

Not a replacement for a career counselor. Use results to start conversations.

Some profession copy is templated; featured roles are enriched manually and via LLM. See the disclaimer banner.

Schools: /b2b. Premium waitlist: /premium.

simulationDisclaimer: Salary and AI-risk estimates are approximate and not professional career counseling.

aiRisk.tooltip: AI-risk: how much routine work in this job may be automated by AI by 2030
aiRisk.summary: AI-risk measures automation exposure, not «will this job disappear».
aiRisk.methodologyBody:
AI-risk (0–100%) is an expert model of tasks LLMs and automation may take over by 2030. Lower scores mean more human interaction, physical work, or regulation. Higher scores mean more templates and routine.

Salaries are category baselines scaled by region — orientation for teens, not a job offer.

Some profession pages use template copy; featured roles are LLM-enriched (badge on page).

Not a career counselor. Ages 12+.
